﻿ECLIPSE × JO KOY: BLUE IN THE FACE
All of this for one night. Jo Koy’s Netflix special, Blue in the Face, was taped in Stockton. Find the moments in Jo’s Variety interview that show the work and the heart behind it, clip them clean, and earn on views.
	 
CPM
$2.00 / 1K
	MAX PER CLIP
$500
	MIN PAYOUT
$2.50
	 
1
CLIP THE VARIETY INTERVIEW
	2
POST ON TIKTOK OR REELS
	3
SUBMIT ON WHOP
	4
GET PAID
	 
⭐ VERY IMPORTANT: JOIN THE ECLIPSE COMMUNITY ⭐
Join our Whop community, Eclipse: whop.com/eclipseclipping · Join it before you start clipping.
	 
🔥 THE FOOTAGE: THE VARIETY INTERVIEW
Jo’s 11-minute sit-down with Variety is the footage for this campaign. Clip from it and only it.
	QUICK FACTS
Client
	Jo Koy: Blue in the Face (Netflix)
	Page Type
	Any page, any size. Clipping, comedy, entertainment and fan pages all work.
	Content
	ONLY the Variety interview (Variety.mp4) in the link below. Footage from anywhere else gets rejected.
	Platforms
	TikTok · Instagram Reels
	Caption
	Your choice. Nothing is required.
	Tagging
	No hashtags or tags required. Optional: tag Jo Koy.
	Audience
	75%+ of views from the US
	 
✔ The goal: a clip that lets people feel the work and the heart Jo put into one night of comedy.
	 
❌ NOT the point: Raw rips with no edit. Clips that end mid-sentence with no clear idea. Cuts that change what Jo meant. Anything that makes Jo look bad.
	WHAT TO DO
It’s easy. Just follow these steps:
* Join the Eclipse community on Whop, then get the Variety interview from the link below.
* Make a short video using ONLY that footage.
* Post it on TikTok or Instagram Reels. Write whatever caption you like.
* Submit your video on Whop, then DM Eclipse in the Whop support chat with your demographics once your analytics and audience section has fully loaded. We approve it and you get paid.
Refer to the “How To Submit” section below if you are unsure how to submit a video.
✔ The interview already did the hard part. Your job is finding the best 15 to 60 seconds worth pulling out.
	WHERE TO GET THE CLIPS
Use ONLY the Variety interview:
* Variety interview (Variety.mp4, 11 min). Moments and timestamps are in the table below. Leave the Variety logo as it appears in the video.
* 00 Variety Interview: Jo’s 11-minute Variety interview (same file as above).
⚠ Do NOT use any clip from outside the Variety interview. Outside clips get rejected right away.
    No other footage of any kind. No trailers, no other interviews, no other comedy.
	DO NOT USE THESE PARTS
* Any cut that changes or misrepresents what Jo or anyone else actually meant.
* Any other footage, including behind-the-scenes clips you saved earlier. Only the Variety interview counts now.
* Anything that calls the Variety interview “clips from the special”. It isn’t the special.
* Anything from outside the Variety interview.
WHAT TO CLIP
Two angles: the work and the heart. Show how hard Jo works, and why this night mattered to him.
WHAT
	WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
	WHERE TO FIND IT
	The process
	How Jo builds a joke: no script, freestyle, acting people out. Why he stopped doing a bit before taping so it stayed fresh.
	Variety 1:11 – 1:38 · 3:53 – 4:28 · 6:16 – 6:48
	The story
	The heart of the special. Jo on Fred, the Dodgers game, and why he always wanted him to see it. Keep it respectful.
	Variety 2:27 – 3:11 · 5:19 – 6:12 (strong language)
	The origin
	How Jo got into comedy: the Richard Pryor tape, Eddie Murphy’s Delirious, the red leather outfit, his first competition.
	Variety 0:34 – 0:58
	Why Stockton
	Jo on the history of Filipinos in Stockton and why he wanted to start the special there.
	Variety 6:54 – 7:37
	The title
	Where the name Blue in the Face came from, and the line that gave it to him.
	Variety 8:04 – 8:34 · 9:58 – 10:09
	The look
	His director’s choice of blue, and how it looked on camera.
	Variety 8:55 – 9:21
	 
⚠ Lead with your strongest, most heartfelt line or moment.
	WHERE TO POST
* 1. TikTok
* 2. Instagram Reels
CAPTION
YOUR CHOICE
* Nothing is required. Write whatever caption you like.
* No hashtags or tags required. Optional: tag Jo Koy.
* Keep it genuine and positive. Write what a real fan would say.
* Keep it true. No made-up facts, quotes or dates.
* Write your own. Do not copy other clippers’ captions.
THE VIBE
The feel we’re going for (not required):
- Heartfelt and real. This is the hard work Jo put in, and what this night meant to him.
- Lead with the strongest line, the heartfelt line, and let it land.
- Keep it simple and warm. Let Jo’s own words and the room speak for themselves.
	EDITING GUIDELINES
* Original audio only. No music, no AI voices.
* Subtitles are welcome, not required.
* 9:16 vertical, fast-paced, no dead air. At least 10 seconds.
* Strong language is fine when it’s Jo’s own words in the footage. Don’t add your own.
* Brand-new edits only. No reposting someone else’s clip.
YOUR AUDIENCE (REQUIRED)
At least 75% of your views must come from: US
	HOW YOU GET PAID
VIEWS ON AN APPROVED CLIP
	YOU EARN
	50,000
	$100
	100,000
	$200
	250,000 or more
	$500 (the max per clip)
	$2.00 per 1,000 views on TikTok and Instagram Reels. A clip needs to earn at least $2.50 to pay out. The campaign budget is $17,500.
FACTS YOU CAN USE
* Jo Koy: Blue in the Face is his Netflix stand-up special.
* It was taped in Stockton, California.
* Jo started stand-up in 1989.
Anything else, ask. Don’t guess.
HOW TO SUBMIT (REQUIRED)
1. Post your video.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Submit it on Whop.
4. Once your analytics and audience section has fully loaded, DM Eclipse in the Whop support chat with your demographics: a screen recording of your analytics with the country breakdown.
5. Wait for approval. Then you get paid out.
⭐ Not in the Eclipse community yet? Join our Whop community: whop.com/eclipseclipping · Very important.
	THE RULES
✅ YOU MUST
	❌ YOU WILL NOT GET PAID IF
	Post to: TikTok and Instagram Reels
	Clips from outside the Variety interview
	Use only the Variety interview footage
	Music, AI voices or other brands in the video
	Keep the original meaning intact
	Cuts that change what Jo said, or made-up claims, quotes or dates
	Keep it positive about Jo
	Anything negative about Jo, or mocking him or anyone in the footage
	At least 10 seconds, in English
	Verdicts, rankings or comparisons to other comedians
	Keep your post up at least 30 days
	Calling the Variety interview “clips from the special”
	Likes are visible (hidden likes = rejected)
	Negative, political or NSFW videos
	At least 0.20% engagement on every post
	Spam, the same video pushed across many pages, or more than 5 posts of one video
	At least 75% of views from the US
	Rage bait, raw rips with no edit, or reposting somebody else’s edit
	DM Eclipse your demographics in the Whop support chat
	Paid ads or boosts, story boosting, bots (the account gets banned)
	 
ECLIPSE · JO KOY: BLUE IN THE FACE CLIPPING BRIEF    Questions? DM Eclipse in the Whop support chat. Contact the Eclipse team, not Jo Koy or his team.
